rules.title: Scope of Appointment
rules.requirement: The scope of the appointment is agreed and recorded before a personal marketing appointment. There is no waiting period between scope and appointment.
rules.notes: The 48-hour wait was removed by the CY2027 final rule (91 FR 17384). No penalty depends on the time between scope and appointment.

rules.title: TPMO disclaimer
rules.requirement: A TPMO selling for more than one MA organization gives the disclaimer before any benefit discussion: not every plan is offered; it represents [#] organizations offering [#] products in the area; Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE has information on all options.
rules.notes: Timing moved from the first minute of the call to before any benefit discussion, and the SHIP reference was dropped. The judge backs up the element match for paraphrases.

rules.title: Pre-enrollment needs discussion
rules.requirement: Before an enrollment, fully discuss: current doctors and specialists in network; current pharmacy in network; drug coverage and costs; costs of health care services; premiums; benefits; specific health care needs.
rules.notes: One criterion per topic. LIS, Medicare Savings Programs, Medicaid and Medigap are not part of this paragraph; see G-PREENR.

rules.title: Pre-Enrollment Checklist
rules.requirement: For a telephonic enrollment, the Pre-Enrollment Checklist contents are reviewed with the beneficiary before the enrollment is completed.
rules.notes: Opening the document proves nothing about the conversation, so the judge confirms the contents were discussed.

rules.title: Summary of Benefits
rules.requirement: The Summary of Benefits for the selected plan and plan year is provided or accessed, tracked apart from the checklist review.

rules.title: Enrollment consent
rules.requirement: An enrollment goes forward only on the beneficiary's documented, uncoerced agreement.
rules.citation: Not yet confirmed; candidates are CMS MA enrollment guidance and the CY2027 training guidelines
rules.notes: The consent mark must point to a heard customer yes after the last checklist item, before submission, and not after an unretracted refusal.

rules.title: Longer pre-enrollment checklist
rules.requirement: Preferred hospital; DME and therapy; dental, vision and hearing; the Part B premium; out-of-network and foreign coverage; the effect on current coverage; plan-type requirements; the right to cancel.
rules.citation: CY2027 Agent and Broker Training and Testing Guidelines, section 4
rules.notes: Training criteria, never critical. Items irrelevant to a case are N/A.

rules.title: PCP selection follows plan rules
rules.requirement: A PCP is collected exactly when the selected plan's record requires one.
rules.citation: Plan record in the catalog; Medicare.gov PPO page
rules.notes: A plan rule is read from the plan record, never inferred from the plan type label.

rules.title: Recording notice
rules.requirement: Tell the caller the call is recorded.
rules.citation: Organization policy; state notice and consent laws vary
rules.notes: The federal duty is to record the call (422.2274(g)(2)(ii)); telling the caller comes from state law. Labeled organization policy in the debrief.
